claims.statement: At n = 2^20 the fixed-base comb in proof.md recovers the BLS12-381 G1 scalar with probability 1. Group operations are the executed EFD schedules dbl-2009-l, add-2007-bl and madd-2007-bl on this curve. Every per-record cost is a product of the record count and a measured instruction delta. Total work is at most W = 5908313823446922466800834637125629747 target-group-operation equivalents. The declared score 122152158/1000000 = 122.152158 is a ceiling of log2(W) at resolution 10^(-6). Peak memory is 114494405109749170093132055902473488384 bytes. Preprocessing is 2115716898391170226114933986 reference units and is included in W. Nonuniform advice is 0 bytes.

experiments.purpose: Remeasure the limb schedule on BLS12-381 G1, rebuild W, check the score ceiling, the factor product, and [r]G = infinity.
